caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object consisting of three main components: a circular, disc-like top section, a central supporting vertical stem, and a broad, shallow circular base. The top section is elaborately decorated with floral and leaf motifs radiating outward from the center and features multiple small oval shapes arranged in a circular pattern at the center, all executed in pastel shades of blue, green, and hints of orange. The central stem is slender, turned, and features a screw-like element near the top where it connects to the disc. The base is shallow, circular, and also lightly decorated with a simple scalloped pattern in matching soft blue and orange tones. The entire composition is rendered in pencil with delicate, light watercolor washes primarily in blue, green, and orange hues. The object is centered on a plain, unadorned background with a faint rectangular border drawn around it.
title: Mirror Support
